sloka: हरीश्वरम् उपागम्य हनुमान् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ।राज्यम् प्राप्तम् यशः चैव कौली श्रीः अभिवर्थिता ॥४-२९-९॥
transliteration: harīśvaram upāgamya hanumān vākyam abravīt ।rājyam prāptam yaśaḥ caiva kaulī śrīḥ abhivarthitā ॥4-29-9॥

translations.english: 'You have attained the kingdom. You have earned fame. The prosperity of your family has gone up. All that remains is to earn the goodwill of friends. Attend to that now.
